text:
morgan: quick RFC follow-up: idea for a "label hints" layer for rollouts. lightweight, client-friendly, and explicitly not a hard pin.
sam: ok, what's minimal shape?
morgan: propose: labels (ordered list), precedence (int, higher=more authoritative), exposure (public|restricted|internal), client_hint (prefer|soft-require|ignore), issued_at (ISO8601), source (ops|auto|client), ttl_seconds (optional).
carla: exposure is handy to gate UI surfaces. good call.
devin: important: precedence is ordering only. compatibility checks (schema/quantization) still gate eligibility. add docs note.
morgan: agree. also add server-side sanity_window_seconds to avoid older high-precedence rollouts stomping.
sam: can we have a tiny example for integrators?
morgan: example manifest (transport layer uses strings): {"labels": ["stable-2026-03","canary-A"], "precedence": "8", "exposure": "public", "client_hint": "prefer", "issued_at": "2026-03-21T16:00:00Z", "source": "ops", "ttl_seconds": "7200"}
carla: router behavior: sort candidates by precedence desc, issued_at desc. iterate and pick first schema-compatible candidate. precedence affects order, not eligibility. emit metric label_conflict if we detect precedence vs recency mismatch.
devin: add metric keys: label_applied (labels, model, source), label_flip, label_conflict, label_stale_hit. include exposure and source in telemetry.
sam: tests: unit for precedence ties and issued_at aging, exposure filtering; e2e sim for decision latency.
morgan: edge-case: backdated issued_at with high precedence. router should consult sanity_window_seconds and prefer most-recent-issued_at when outside the window, and increment label_conflict. ops can still create hard pins via pin flow when needed.
carla: action items: @carla update schema docs and publish, @sam add tests + sim harness, @devin implement sorting + sanity window and telemetry, @morgan update RFC note.
ops-bot: deploybot: rollout created by @carla for model opt-2b labels=[stable-2026-03,exp-B] precedence=7 exposure=restricted ttl_seconds=3600
morgan: thanks. small follow-up: please add unit test for multi-label ordering where client prefers second label if first fails compatibility.
sam: on it. :+1:
